title: Wellbeing that needs constant upkeep

captions.energy: Clinging to a compulsory comfort level

meaning: An organised home brings joy while its familiar level of comfort does not become an obligation governing your whole shared life.
text: Comfort at home may result from being organised: essentials anticipated, costs understood and tasks completed without unnecessary bustle. The Emperor in the physical position of Muladhara describes this arrangement. The Devil in energy tests your footing through attachment to a particular comfort level: the familiar becomes difficult to relinquish even when maintaining it grows demanding. The Sun in emotions enjoys visible wellbeing, looking around and feeling you have succeeded. That joy is real, yet can conceal how much freedom and time together preserving the domestic picture now requires.

For example, you establish an attractive table setting for every dinner. Special crockery, elaborate menus and compulsory preparation gradually follow, even on busy days. **A pleasant result need not become a daily requirement.** You can value a beautiful table while allowing an ordinary dinner to be simpler. Visible wellbeing remains a pleasure, and a thoughtfully arranged home releases effort instead of continually demanding proof of the previous comfort level.

The difficulty is experiencing simplification as falling below an acceptable standard. You organise preparation more precisely and try to finish faster without reducing the obligation itself. Joy becomes harder although appearances remain. Greater peace comes from recognising the value of what you have achieved and using it freely, without demonstrating each evening that your home still deserves admiration.
